dz: 在英格兰国王亨利三世与由西蒙·德·蒙福特所领导的他叛逆的男爵之间的冲突中,法国国王路易九世发布了"阿米恩斯之米斯"(Mise of Amiens),这是片面支持亨利的决定,后来导致了第二次男爵战争.
de: In the conflict between King Henry III of England and his rebellious barons led by Simon de Montfort, King Louis IX of France issues the Mise of Amiens, a one-sided decision in favour of Henry that later leads to the Second Barons' War.
